name: Escalation ~Aoi Houyou~
source:
Our girl is a student at a private girls school. Day dreaming about the girl she loves during class isn't too wise. During a special lesson, she found out that there are pets in this school and she is invited to be one. Well, if she gets friendly with the girl she loves and her room mate, she will be fine, maybe even be happy. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
我们的女孩是私立女子学校的学生。在课堂上梦见她爱的女孩不太明智。在一次特殊的课程中，她发现这所学校有宠物，并邀请她成为其中的一员。好吧，如果她和她爱的女孩和她的室友友好相处，她会没事的，甚至可能会很高兴。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
